chars.SARA: SARA: a young woman wearing a bright mustard-yellow oversized hoodie, light-blue ripped jeans and white sneakers, small gold hoop earrings.
chars.AMINE: AMINE: a young man wearing a red-and-black checked flannel shirt open over a white t-shirt, black joggers with white side stripes.
chars.KARIM: KARIM: a young man wearing a dark green bomber jacket, grey hoodie underneath, beige cargo trousers.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: A crowded messy student apartment living room in Casablanca at night, party lights, other young people dancing in the background. KARIM leans over and pours a drink from a plain unlabeled bottle into SARA's red plastic cup while she holds it out, both laughing, SARA looks a bit nervous and surprised.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same party living room. SARA throws her head back and drinks the whole red plastic cup in one go while KARIM and two other young people cheer and clap around her, wide open laughing mouths.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: The party at its peak: a hazy, smoky living room full of young people dancing and laughing under colorful lights, empty red plastic cups and pizza boxes on a low table, SARA in the middle laughing with her eyes half closed.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: SARA sits on a worn sofa holding her spinning head with both mitten hands, dizzy swirl lines around her head, the party lights blurred behind her, a red plastic cup tipped over on the floor.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: SARA stumbles alone down a narrow dim apartment hallway, one hand on the wall, the loud party glowing at the far end behind her, doors along the hallway.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: A dark small bedroom with a cheap Moroccan blanket on a bed, moonlight from a window. AMINE is passed out face down on one side of the bed fully clothed, snoring. SARA, exhausted, lies down on the other edge of the bed with her back to him, eyes closing.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Morning sunlight through the curtains of the messy small bedroom. SARA sits up in bed holding her aching head with one hand, squinting, mouth twisted in pain, hangover.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Morning in the small bedroom. SARA, sitting up in bed, turns and sees AMINE sleeping right next to her fully clothed under the blanket; SARA's eyes are huge and her mouth is wide open in shock, both hands raised.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: SARA jumps out of the bed and stands frozen in the middle of the bedroom, looking down at herself in horror, hands on her cheeks; AMINE is still asleep in the bed behind her, unaware.
